_README: Copy this file to profile/applicant.json and fill in real values.
This file is the source of truth for every personal fact the harness submits.
The harness never infers or invents a value that is missing here.
Leave a field as an empty string if it does not apply; the harness will treat
the corresponding form question as unanswerable and block the application

demographic_response_policy._note: Set each to 'decline' to select a prefer-not-to-say option, or to the exact self-disclosed value you want submitted. The harness never guesses these.

cover_letter_policy._note: generate = compose from profile facts only; skip = leave optional cover letters blank; file = upload cover_letter_path
